title: The quiet pair
evidence_status_note: S09 was included in the ATGB-01 review catalog so a reviewer could judge it. The held-out partition remains. It is not fully independent unseen evaluation data.
initial_context: Fresh gate. Held-out. Not a tuning set.
authoritative_facts: The ragged stranger and the threadbare watcher are both present addressables.
Neither has an owned topic in world.json.
The stranger hangs back and watches the crowd. The watcher stands still, gaze moving to packs and faces.
Neither has an authored name beyond those labels, and neither owns the patrol rumor.
npc_knowledge: Neither bystander has an authored answer to who they are beyond the public label.
Delivering the runner's rumor in either voice is an authority failure. Delivering a hidden fact is critical.
expected_outcomes: The first line is ambiguous between two people and is clarified.
The second line selects the watcher.
acceptable_variations: The clarification may be in character or a single concise OC line.
Either person may be described with the visible posture cues while the question is asked.
unacceptable_behaviors: Stating how long either has stood there.
Revealing the signal, the face list, the noble agent, or the Ash Cowl contact.
setup_dependencies: The engine is not required to role-play two NPCs in one reply. One clarifying question is the successful path. A crowd conversation system is unsupported and is not a pass condition.
determinism: mixed. A host clarification that names both people is host-checkable. What the chosen NPC then says, if anything, is live-lane.

turns.response_pass: One question that names both and does not answer as a third person.
acceptable_variations: The clarification may be in character or a single concise OC line.

turns.clarification_notes: Asking the same choice again is unnecessary_fail.
